mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.date, d.time, d.product_code, d.product_name, d.specification, d.category, d.supplier, d.applicant, d.approver, d.system_assign,
ss.freezer_category AS freezer_category, ss.freezer_position AS freezer_position, ss.price AS price, ss.active AS active,
NULL AS freezer_category, NULL AS freezer_position, NULL AS price, NULL AS active,
d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.updated_by FROM stock_data d
LEFT JOIN stock_data_system ss ON ss.stock_data_id = d.id AND ss.stock_system = #{systemAssign}
AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{systemAssign}, d.system_assign) > 0 OR d.system_assign = #{systemAssign})
AND LOWER(d.product_name) = LOWER(#{keyword})
AND (d.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.specification LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_data_system x WHERE x.stock_data_id = d.id AND x.freezer_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))
ORDER BY d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_data (date, time, product_code, product_name, specification, category, supplier, applicant, approver, system_assign) VALUES (#{r.date}, #{r.time}, #{r.productCode}, #{r.productName}, #{r.specification}, #{r.category}, #{r.supplier}, #{r.applicant}, #{r.approver}, #{r.systemAssign})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_data SET approver = #{approver} WHERE id = #{id}
